# [Implementation] - Post-359 run review: smoke-section heading scoping, sandbox-path false rejects, APPROVAL pause hint

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #362 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

Run every block from the worktree root, **after `npm run build`** (Quality Gate target 1): the blocks
read `dist/`, so `dist/` must be the branch build. Block **S2** reads the archived #359 plan from the
repository the worktree belongs to (`git rev-parse --git-common-dir`) because `artifacts/plans/` is
untracked and therefore absent from a fresh worktree; it prints `SKIP` and exits 0 when the archive
is absent. Block **S4** is the only state-mutating block: it creates its sandbox under
`$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-362-…` (recognised by the state guard) and removes it via an `EXIT` trap.

**Ordering note for the implementer:** S3 deliberately embeds `/tmp` and bare-`mktemp -d` sandbox
text as *data*, so on the **pre-fix** build S3 (and this plan's own protocol) is reported
non-executable by the very rule it fixes. That is expected and correct: the gate validates the plan
after IMPLEMENT, with the fixed build. Do not "simplify" S3 into shapes the old validator tolerates —
that would delete the probe matrix the issue asks to pin.

**S1 — a plan whose H1 carries the section phrase scopes the section, not the document**

```bash
set -eu
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
node -e '
const { SmokeProtocol } = require("./dist/domain");
const withPhrase = [
  "# [Implementation] - [Phase 6] [Bug] the Manual Smoke Test Protocol heading scoping defect",
  "",
  "## 2. Findings",
  "",
  "```bash",
  "$ node -e \"console.log(1)\"",
  "```",
  "",
  "```bash",
  "+------+",
  "| a    |",
  "+------+",
  "```",
  "",
  "### Quality Gate Targets",
  "",
  "```bash",
  "npm run lint",
  "```",
  "",
  "### Manual Smoke Test Protocol",
  "",
  "**S1 one**",
  "",
  "```bash",
  "echo S1",
  "```",
  "",
  "**S2 two**",
  "",
  "```bash",
  "echo S2",
  "```",
  "",
  "**S3 three**",
  "",
  "```bash",
  "echo S3",
  "```",
  ""
].join("\n");
const scrubbed = withPhrase.replace(/^# .*$/m, "# [Implementation] - normalized title");
const a = SmokeProtocol.fromPlan(withPhrase);
const b = SmokeProtocol.fromPlan(scrubbed);
if (a.headingLine < 2) { console.log("FAIL: scoped at line " + a.headingLine + " (the document H1)"); process.exit(1); }
if (a.checks.length !== 3) { console.log("FAIL: " + a.checks.length + " checks frozen, expected 3"); process.exit(1); }
const labels = a.checks.map((c) => c.label).join("|");
if (labels !== "S1 one|S2 two|S3 three") { console.log("FAIL: labels " + labels); process.exit(1); }
if (a.headingLine !== b.headingLine || a.checks.length !== b.checks.length) { console.log("FAIL: the H1 phrase changed extraction"); process.exit(1); }
if (a.toScript() !== b.toScript()) { console.log("FAIL: toScript differs with the phrase in the H1"); process.exit(1); }
const script = a.toScript();
const markers = (script.match(/__AGYLOOP_SMOKE_CHECK_[0-9]+__/g) || []).length;
if (markers !== 3) { console.log("FAIL: the script has " + markers + " markers, expected 3"); process.exit(1); }
if (/^[ \t]*\$ /m.test(script)) { console.log("FAIL: the script carries a shell-prompt line"); process.exit(1); }
if (script.includes("npm run lint") || script.includes("+------+")) { console.log("FAIL: the script froze a pre-section fence"); process.exit(1); }
console.log("OK S1: H1 phrase ignored - heading line " + a.headingLine + ", 3 checks, 3 markers");
'
```

**S2 — the merged validator accepts the #359 plan, and its frozen protocol runs verbatim**

```bash
set -eu
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
COMMON_DIR="$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null || true)"
case "${COMMON_DIR:-}" in
  /*) STATE_ROOT="$(dirname "$COMMON_DIR")" ;;
  *) STATE_ROOT="$REPO_ROOT" ;;
esac
PLAN_FILE="$(ls -d "$STATE_ROOT"/artifacts/plans/359-*/implementation_plan.md 2>/dev/null | head -1)"
if [ -z "${PLAN_FILE:-}" ]; then
  echo "SKIP S2: no archived #359 plan under $STATE_ROOT/artifacts/plans"
  exit 0
fi
PROTOCOL_FILE="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$PROTOCOL_FILE"' EXIT
export PLAN_FILE REPO_ROOT PROTOCOL_FILE
node -e '
const { SmokeProtocol } = require(process.env.REPO_ROOT + "/dist/domain");
const fs = require("fs");
const p = SmokeProtocol.fromPlan(fs.readFileSync(process.env.PLAN_FILE, "utf8"));
if (!p.executable || p.findings.length !== 0) {
  console.log("FAIL: the merged validator rejects the #359 plan: " + JSON.stringify(p.findings));
  process.exit(1);
}
if (p.headingLine < 2) { console.log("FAIL: scoped at the H1 (line " + p.headingLine + ")"); process.exit(1); }
if (p.checks.length !== 3) { console.log("FAIL: " + p.checks.length + " checks, expected 3"); process.exit(1); }
const labels = p.checks.map((c) => c.label.slice(0, 2)).join(" ");
if (labels !== "S1 S2 S3") { console.log("FAIL: labels " + labels); process.exit(1); }
fs.writeFileSync(process.env.PROTOCOL_FILE, p.toScript());
console.log("OK S2a: #359 protocol executable - heading " + p.headingLine + ", checks " + p.checks.length + ", findings 0");
'
bash "$PROTOCOL_FILE"
echo "OK S2b: the frozen #359 protocol ran verbatim with exit 0"
```

**S3 — the sandbox-path probe matrix classifies every documented shape**

```bash
set -eu
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
node -e '
const { SmokeProtocol } = require("./dist/domain");
const HEAD = ["# Plan", "", "## 6. Manual Smoke Test Protocol", "", "```bash"];
const TAIL = ["```", ""];
const findingsFor = (body) => SmokeProtocol.fromPlan([...HEAD, ...body, ...TAIL].join("\n"))
  .findings.filter((f) => f.rule === "sandbox-path").length;

// The #359 S2 shape: plan TEXT seeded inside a node -e script, where the
// sandbox path uses escaped quotes and the invocation is env-prefixed.
const seeded = [
  String.raw`  "SBX=$(mktemp -d \"$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-362-x\")",`,
  "  \"env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node bin/codeloop.js transition --issue 362\","
];

const rows = [
  ["real invocation + clean sandbox", ["SBX=$(mktemp -d \"$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-362-x\")", "env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node bin/codeloop.js transition --issue 362"], 0],
  ["quoted command text over a /tmp path (I4)", ["SBX=$(mktemp -d /tmp/opencode/smoke362-XXXXXX)", "\"node bin/codeloop.js transition --issue 362\""], 0],
  ["quoted env-prefixed text over a /tmp path (I4 complete)", ["SBX=$(mktemp -d /tmp/opencode/smoke362-XXXXXX)", "\"env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node bin/codeloop.js transition --issue 362\""], 0],
  ["seeded escaped path + env-prefixed text", seeded, 0],
  ["explicit non-temp template under PWD", ["SBX=$(mktemp -d \"$PWD/fixture-XXXXXX\")", "node bin/codeloop.js status --issue 362"], 0],
  ["bare mktemp -d (OS temp root)", ["SBX=$(mktemp -d)", "node bin/codeloop.js transition --issue 362"], 1],
  ["explicit /tmp root", ["SBX=$(mktemp -d /tmp/opencode/smoke362-XXXXXX)", "node bin/codeloop.js transition --issue 362"], 1],
  ["variable-indirected recognised root", ["SANDBOX=\"$HOME/.cache/agyloop\"; WS=\"$(mktemp -d \"$SANDBOX/smoke-362-XXXXXX\")\"", "node bin/codeloop.js status --issue 362"], 0],
  ["variable indirection onto /tmp", ["D=/tmp/opencode; W=$(mktemp -d \"$D/smoke-362-XXXXXX\")", "node bin/codeloop.js status --issue 362"], 1],
  ["HOME override (accepted limitation)", ["home=\"$(mktemp -d)\"", "HOME=\"$home\" node bin/codeloop.js review --issue 362"], 1]
];

let failed = 0;
for (const [name, body, expected] of rows) {
  const actual = findingsFor(body);
  if (actual !== expected) {
    failed++;
    console.log("FAIL: " + name + " -> " + actual + " sandbox finding(s), expected " + expected);
  }
}
if (failed > 0) process.exit(1);
console.log("OK S3: " + rows.length + "/" + rows.length + " probe-matrix rows classify as specified");
'
```

**S4 — an APPROVAL pause presents one next step; TRIAGE keeps its resume hint**

```bash
set -eu
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
SBX="$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-362-pause-XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$SBX"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$SBX/.agyloop" "$SBX/.worktrees/99"
export SBX REPO_ROOT

seed() {
  node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const dir = process.env.SBX;
const stage = process.argv[1];
const at = "2026-10-29T15:08:03.122Z";
fs.writeFileSync(dir + "/.agyloop/state.json", JSON.stringify({
  version: "1.0.0",
  currentStage: stage,
  mode: "standard",
  issue: 99,
  baseBranch: "main",
  worktree: { taskId: 99, worktreePath: dir + "/.worktrees/99", branch: "task/99", baseBranch: "main", createdAt: at },
  pausedAtGate: stage,
  pausedAtTimestamp: at,
  createdAt: at,
  updatedAt: at,
  history: [{ stage: stage, timestamp: at }]
}));
' "$1"
}

seed APPROVAL
( cd "$SBX" && node "$REPO_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --json > "$SBX/approval.json" 2> "$SBX/approval.err" )
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.SBX + "/approval.json", "utf8"));
const stderr = fs.readFileSync(process.env.SBX + "/approval.err", "utf8");
if (payload.actionType !== "human_gate") { console.log("FAIL: actionType " + payload.actionType); process.exit(1); }
if (payload.pause === null || payload.pause.resumeCommand !== null) {
  console.log("FAIL: the APPROVAL pause still advertises a resume command: " + JSON.stringify(payload.pause));
  process.exit(1);
}
if (!/codeloop implement/.test(payload.pause.message)) {
  console.log("FAIL: the pause message does not name the command: " + payload.pause.message);
  process.exit(1);
}
if (!/codeloop transition IMPLEMENT/.test(payload.humanSummary)) {
  console.log("FAIL: the humanSummary no longer names the transition command: " + payload.humanSummary);
  process.exit(1);
}
if (/codeloop resume/.test(payload.pause.message)) {
  console.log("FAIL: the pause message still says resume: " + payload.pause.message);
  process.exit(1);
}
if (stderr.includes("🛑") || /codeloop resume/.test(stderr)) {
  console.log("FAIL: the blocker banner contradicts the gate: " + stderr.trim());
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log("OK S4a: APPROVAL presents one next step - resumeCommand null, message names the command");
'

seed TRIAGE
( cd "$SBX" && node "$REPO_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --json > "$SBX/triage.json" 2> "$SBX/triage.err" )
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.SBX + "/triage.json", "utf8"));
if (payload.pause === null || payload.pause.resumeCommand !== "codeloop resume") {
  console.log("FAIL: a TRIAGE pause must still advertise resume: " + JSON.stringify(payload.pause));
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log("OK S4b: TRIAGE still advertises codeloop resume");
'
```
